title: Trunk or Treat
summary: If you are looking for a safe, welcoming, and fun evening for your family, come by the church this Saturday, October 31st, from 6-8pm, for our "Trunk or Treat" event!

title: Special Thanksgiving Service at Baker Branch Free Will Baptist
summary: Come be with us at Baker Branch FWB in Tutor Key as we fellowship with our brothers and sisters in Christ and offer our thanks to God through worship! The Flat Gap Baptist Church singers will be praising the Lord in song and Pastor Eric Lauterwasser will be bringing the message.

title: Guest Preacher
summary: Brother Parker Estep will be ministering to us in Word and song during the 11am service. Hope to see you there!
